notes.title: About unused steam keys
notes.notes:
Im is sorry. sorry!

Im did wrote im would revoke any unsold keys that was sold from a contain site (im have deleted the news). But a closer look about those, its was really just from a single bundle and a another bundle with two other games (which is now free, so no reasons to revoke them at atll).

So: Im will NOT revoke ANY keys at all! So fell free whatever you want do with them! Im will NOT revoke them. Im is 100% complete sorry for this drama and is a 100% mistake from my side!

This is NOT your fault, its was a publisher fault. This is a issue between me and the previous publisher and not you.

notes.title: Still updating the game.
notes.notes:
Im do still update the game and also got "catch" a spelling, first noticed here today: There is only 20 levels in the game, not 21 levels. Sorry for the confuction. For some reason, one level was gone and cant find the file again.

But Im do updated the game, after the game original release, so you do now have better and easier jump control with limited air control, which was not present in the original. Now the game should been quite easier to control with the 3 input method. The jumping control caused some of the negative release.

notes.title: Easier Jump control is coming soon!!
notes.notes:
In a late October release, the Jumping have been made easier:

Normal jump button is now easier to control and you have now even have limited air control as well as well you can jump direct up. That should been easier to control the bird for causel players. 

Hardcore players should sticks to Jump Left and Jump Right as originally designed.

Now this game is changed to a "Bounty Bob Strike Back" meeting "Snokie" gameplay.

The release day is when im home again on my own computer on around wendensday
